mechanism: A mechanism that prevents system stagnation by injecting {{entropy}} (randomness/noise) into decision-making processes. It acts as a counterbalance to convergence, ensuring that the system explores the solution space rather than getting stuck in local optima. By adding {{noise}}, it forces re-evaluation of settled states.
gloss: Controlled randomization to escape convergence deadlocks
failure_modes: Insufficient injection failing to break persistent deadlocks.
invariants: Names the target it injects {{noise}} into.
Injects at most `max_injection`, so a productive {{equilibrium}} survives the perturbation.
Runs as a standing counterbalance to convergence, not on a detected stall.

parameters.name: max_injection
parameters.description: Largest share of the target's state a single injection may perturb.
